comparison.objective: Arrange five glazed pots in a kiln with specified clearances; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Clearance-constrained multi-object placement and layout planning versus hex-key alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires upright pots with 2 cm inter-object/post and 1.5 cm wall clearance; no complete spec version or full staged rubric is present. Candidate requires repeatable non-bottoming carriage stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is collision-free spatial packing, not mechanism commissioning.
